'''Hantzig''' was a person who worked for [[Kueller]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. During the [[Bombing of Pydyr]], he co-ordinated an operation on [[Pydyr]] to have about 1000 [[Pydyrian]]s imprisoned within their homes.
